translations: O my sons Go and inquire about
Yusuf and his brother and not despair
of (the) Mercy of Allah (the) Mercy of Allah
of (the) Mercy of Allah (the) Mercy of Allah
puzzle.hint: A powerful message of hope from Prophet Yaqub (Jacob) to his sons — never lose hope in Allah's mercy.
puzzle.arabic: يَـٰبَنِىَّ ٱذْهَبُوا۟ فَتَحَسَّسُوا۟ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people."
